name: Corsair's Cufflinks

effects.name: Armor Bonus
effects.tooltip: Armor Bonus +5 : This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +5 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.

effects.name: Haggle
effects.tooltip: Haggle +5 : Passive: +5 Competence bonus to the Haggle skill.

effects.name: Attack Bonus
effects.tooltip: Attack Bonus +1 : Provides a +1 competence bonus to your attack rolls .

effects.name: Corsair's Cunning
effects.tooltip: Corsair's Cunning : 2 Item Set Bonus: Underwater Action 3 Item Set Bonus: Feather Falling

flavor_text: Fancy cufflinks! The sign of a pirate with a sense of fashion.
tips: The Pirate Treasure Map , the 3 items from the Corsair's Cunning set, the 4 'Scoundrel's type' weapons and Brine Shaman's Staff have a chance of appearing in the end reward list of any of the Three-Barrel Cove (heroic) quests, except Guard Duty . Every third completion you will receive a complete list.
